comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Adding to Ming Mei's above statement: Seems pretty fair to me that if people decide to spend money on keeping a relatively obscure, under-appreciated game in business, they ought to get some sort of compensation for their troubles. Otherwise, what motivation do they have to invest in the game at all? Devotion to something they enjoy? Not very many folks would be that altruistic, myself included.

And if you can show me a single MMO that doesn't follow the model of "people that buy our cash items will have some sort of advantage over those who don't", I'll be... amused, because there's still going to be the 'unfair' advantage of those who've played and reached certain levels of power, versus those just starting out. (Or do you believe a 1/1/1 player wearing uber EQ could seriously trump a 75/75/75 player with maxed finesse and battle skills?)

But yeah, OGP forums would be a better place to discuss this, so the folks running the game right now could hear a different side of the "UNFAIR!" argument. Hm... *vanishes back into the digital mists*

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: How do you know if a ship from the NC/OG shop is better than those from the default free in-game variants ? Go to the 'Ship' segment of this wiki and look it up. Compare Frigate and a Modified Frigate. A Frigate has 3 broadside, 0 Bow and 1 Stern slot for cannons. A Modified Frigate (NC/OG item) has 5 BROADSIDE SLOTS, 1 bow and 0 stern turret. A free ship that's default in game comes with 3 broad side cannon slots and you pay some money .... wow .... 5 broadside cannon slots. Let's say I mount Master's Cannon (16) on both ships. I could theoretically mount 48 M.Cannon.16 on a normal Frigate and 80 M.Cannon.16 on a paid Modified Frigate. I have not take into account the cannon limitations on both ships and other limitations. 80 cannons vs 48 cannons. 5 cannon slots vs 3 cannon slots. You know what I mean ? Look at other ships. Not just stats and skills and user requirements but their ship parts slots and the amount of sailors and cargo and all other stats.
